a.lede: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
a.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent

b.lede: Meta will now allow you to build customized, app-like experiences within its Muse AI assistant. The new feature, called "spaces," allows Muse to build things like a shopping hub, school dashboard, music tracker, trivia game, and more, which you can interact with directly in the app. If you connect your space to a relevant app, […]
b.title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now
